fusions.name: Hive Wake
fusions.desc: Looses 4 stings in a spread, each dealing 5 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Busy Sting
fusions.desc: Darts a sting that deals 4 damage with a 20% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. You move 8% faster for 2 seconds after each one.

fusions.name: Paddling Beneath
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Waxed Feathers
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it. You take 10% less poison damage.
